dependency_order: An `investigation-log` maintains log-level definitions and admits entry-local terms before the observation or hypothesis that needs them (§4.4).

slots.name: Subject
slots.description: The system, behavior, or question under investigation.

slots.name: Scope
slots.description: Included and excluded environments, versions, time range, and stop condition.

slots.name: Governing artifacts
slots.description: Links to the design, procedure, incident, issue, or other source that authorizes or frames the investigation. Write "None" with a reason when no such artifact exists.

slots.name: Admitted terms
slots.description: The log-wide admitted-term set and definition links; entry-local terms are admitted inside their entry.

slots.name: Objective
slots.description: The question this entry is intended to answer.

slots.name: Configuration or context
slots.description: Absolute settings, inputs, environment, or non-experimental context needed to interpret observations. Include both configuration and context when both matter.

slots.name: Observations
slots.description: What happened or was found, with source and measurements where available. Include no causal claim.

slots.name: Interpretation
slots.description: What the observations support and do not support. Write "No interpretation yet" when evidence is insufficient.

slots.name: Next step
slots.description: The next discriminating check, decision, or stop condition, stated as a plan.

mutation_policies.note: A recorded entry is fixed. A correction is a new dated entry that cites the earlier one.
